nom: La Roche-Posay Pure Vitamin C Anti-Wrinkle Firming Eye Cream

avis.texte: Very dissapointed with this product the price is way too up high and it didn't make any changes it actually made everything worse . I went in store and a speciallist recommended me this product . I told her that it was only a vascular underbag problem, not hyperpigmentation thinking it would actually work . Now it created a problem i never had before (pufiness and swollen of the area ) thing that i never experienced before . It didn't even improve the darkness at all. I dont know yall but i defenitely wouldnt recommend this product .

Only using the face wash from this brand. Other products labeled for sensitive skin are not for those who have seriously sensitive skin. Another vitamin c serum from this brand gave me such a bad reaction i almost had to go to urgent care if someone didnt give me a natural oil that calmed the area.

avis.titre: Product itself is great - the packaging not so much.
avis.texte: When I received it - the top was broken off. So I've been using saran wrap to cover the top as the top will not screw back on. I like the actual product but think they need to fix the mechanics a bit.
This could actually be good product to use, but because the tube and cap when trying to close waste the product… Do not waste your money on this until they change this defect!!!
I use the eye cream for about two weeks, it does brighten the skin slightly, and not greasy. No fragrance, so good for allergy eyes.
Very expensive and not effective. It did not work. Not even a a tiny difference was noticed.

the product feels great on my eyes, however, the cap makes it hard to close and I have wasted so much product already trying to close the bottle. Not practical at all & will not be purchasing again unless they change the cap.
Did not work nearly as well as I had hoped on my under-eye bags. It actually seemed to make them worse. Quite disappointing, as I use several other products from this company, and love them all!
It is just the right consistency and hydrates well. We will see if it helps with dark circles. So far I like it. Good under makeup
La Roche Posey is the best product I have found for super sensitive skin and eczema flair ups. This product leaves my eyes looking alert and bright! No negative reaction.
Really nice eye cream. It feels really hydrating and I think it brightens my under eyes. I use this in the morning since it has vitamin c

I've only been using this for product for days but will not buy again. To open it, you have to remove the seal but then can't get the lid back on. I literally had to shove it back on and about 1/3 of the product was wasted all over my hands. Never had this happen and for that reason I won't ever buy this product again.
This eye creme is my go-to. It smooths out any swelling from a morning wakeup and adds brightness. Goes on easy and works under my concealer. Over time this has improved my under eye area.

avis.titre: Best eye lift on the market
avis.texte: Vitamin C Complex eye cream is the best at reducing eye wrinkles and dark circles.

avis.titre: Best Eye Cream for Sensitive Eyes
avis.texte: Best eye cream I have ever used. I have really sensitive eyes and don't have much luck with eye creams. This is an absolutely wonderful cream which has lightened the dark circles under my eyes whilst keeping the eye area moist, bright and fresh looking. Also great value for money and I love the squeeze tube.
Eye serum feels good. I only had for a few days, so can't say how well it works

I wanted to incorporate eye creams into my beauty routine, so I chose this one because I already use 6 other la roche posay products and they work really well, but after using this for a day I noticed rashes around my eyes. I am a little disappointed because this wasn't cheap and I have an event to host this Saturday. I wonder if I could get a refund since this cream doesn't work for me. Or maybe a different product to replace it. With that being said, I still love this brand and all the other products I've purchased from them have been working so well on my skin.

Great cream, but the cap on the tube is terrible. You have to press it down, which of course squeezes the product out. I'm going to the store now to buy a travel tube to transfer the product into as im tired of wrestling with it. I'm not sure how this tube made it out into production. It's too expensive to be this much work to use. But I highly recommend what's in the tube!

This is the first time I have used Pure Vitamin C Eye Cream. I like the creamy texture of it, but it is not so thick that you have to tug on your skin to pat it in. I have started to see the fine line disappearing.

I am 20 years old and have some wrinkle for under eye after useing eye cream cerave and i want use this eye cream vitamin c and i so nervous because my age less and my wrinkles so new and you what suggest me to use each one this eye cream product laroch

This products is incredibly affordable and gentle for a Vitamin C eye cream. Though it is not brightening, nor firming in my opinion, but it smooths the lower orbital very well, provides all the necessary moisture for those you need deep, hydrating moisture and NOT de-puffing, while giving the best Vitamin C/Vitamin E combination and is shea butter enriched. If used in a Korean Regimen, this product can be layered.
I love this eye cream. it absorbs well on the skin but don't apply it too close to your eyeballs cause it does cause a little of stinging.

I just purchased the Vitamin C Eye cream and applied it for the first time last night before bed. Even though I didn't rest well, I noticed first thing this morning that the skin around my eyes looks so hydrated like if I had the most restful sleep! I'm so surprised it even worked overnight! I also love that the cream is light and non irritating on my hypersensitive skin. This is another amazing LaRoche-Posay product to add to my skincare routine.
A great eye cream that is light and doesn't irritate my eyes.
It gives moisture but its stick moisture . I have been using it for about 2 months & see absolutely no difference
Very good product! I noticed a difference in the texture around my eyes! Much smoother
Just started using this! Love that it is very light! So far I'm thinking it may be my fave eye product.
I have used this from November through March and I have seen no results. If anything my circles and wrinkles got worse.
Doesn't work. I am not seeing the dark under my eyes lighten at all or go away. I spoke with a representative about what product to buy and this was her recommendation. Disappointed
The cream is nice but the container it is in is very crummy. It is hard to close and waste alot of the product.

avis.titre: Will stop using this product after 20 years
avis.texte: If I could give it no stars, I would. The change in formula is horrible. I don't want a "filler", I want the same light under eye treatment that you have produced for years. I have been using this product for 20+ years. I will no longer be buying this product in it's current form. It is sticky, goopy and doesn't perform the way the former formula used to.

I did not see any benefits with this eye cream. It does absorb quickly which is nice. Beyond that, it didn't improve texture, color, puffiness. My main issue is puffiness and slight darkness. I was hoping adding a vitamin cream would help with color and the thin eye skin as so many experts advise. I just didn't see results

avis.titre: The Pure Vitamin C is a better product
avis.texte: I haven't noticed any changes in the dark circles or bags under my eyes

This stuff is absolutely magic in a bottle! If you have dark circles, you need to try this product now! It is amazing at getting rid of dark circles at an excellent price! Plus since it's so small, it lasts awhile!

Love this truly. I like the packaging it comes in and I love the texture. The only thing is I only use this at night time now. If I wear it during the day and it mixes with my sunscreen it pills which I can't stand. So this is nighttime eye cream. It doesn't have a stinky smell. I recommend this and would buy again.
Pure Vitamin C is an outstanding eye cream. Eye area looks and feels moisturized.

I like a lot of products from this brand but this one did NOT work for me. It didn't soak into my skin and just oxidized and turned yellow, making it look like I had bruises under my eyes. I also found the packaging confusing.
This is a fine eye cream. Does the job of moisturizing my under eye skin.
Not sure if it works, too soon to tell. I use this interchangeably with the other brands.

This product is great when I finally figured out how to get the top off and on correctly-for some reason, the entire thing came off when I first opened, and was difficult to get back on as well as get the cream to come out without a mess that later dried and cut crusty. A bad packaging design, maybe? I have not used it enough yet to really gauge its effects or compare to another company's product that I relied on for decades.
Amazing product, I noticed a difference in just a couple of days. Very reasonably priced as well
I have been using am & pm for a two months. No major improvements and no moisture. :( I have dryness problem right know. I think I will need for different eye creams.

I really liked your Active C eye cream. I'm sure you had your reasons for discontinuing it, but I had been using it for at least 10 years and had terrific results especially under my eyes. I was rather upset and have had somewhat ok results with this new cream but don't like it nearly as much. I'm currently looking for a new eye cream elsewhere.

avis.titre: Makes the skin under my eyes puffy
avis.texte: I bought from this company for their spf face moisturizers (big disappointment) and decided to try this product as well. I wake up with the puffiest eyes. I reapply in the morning after washing my face (with the la roche face wash) and I continue to look like I just woke or like I've been crying all day long. I honestly never leave reviews but I've had to leave a review on every product I bought from this company. The results have just been so blatantly negative.

avis.titre: Great product for younger skin types.
avis.texte: Great product for my daughter but I prefer Refermic R eye cream my mature skin.

I honestly haven't found an eye cream that has significantly shown me anything extraordinary or even set itself apart from the other products on the market, to be honest, this one included. It did make the area around my eyes softer, which makes the application of makeup easier, but overall I did not notice a difference in my skin.
My skin especially my face has been getting very dry. I tried this and started seeing the moister coming back as well as not looking so tired.
I totally love the way my face feels each and everyday. I get compliments that my face is glowing and what I'm using. So I have recommended the product to family and friends ❤
My skin especially my face has been getting very dry. I tried this and started seeing the moister coming back as well as not looking so tired.
Very light and not grassy at all! And super effective in reducing wrinkles

I honestly haven't found an eye cream that has significantly shown me anything extraordinary or even set itself apart from the other products on the market, to be honest, this one included. It did make the area around my eyes softer, which makes the application of makeup easier, but overall I did not notice a difference in my skin.
I've never found an eye cream that takes care of fine lines as well as provide tightening and lifting for your eye lids! I'm sold on this product and will be using exclusively from now on!

I haven't noticed much if any results, but it feels good on the skin

avis.titre: Moisturizing and Helps with Dark Circles
avis.texte: Awesome eye cream- great for fine lines and dark circles. Made my skin feel soft, smooth, and glowing. A little oily for use under makeup, I found it best to be used as a night cream.
I never used an eye cream. before, but this will def be part of my daily routine!

Vitamin C in an eye cream is a dream come true! I want a youthful and bright eye area and this eye cream is definitely giving me what I want. Its so creamy, light and glides in skin. I strongly recommend this eye cream.
The eye cream works well. I like that it does not contain much of a scent.

avis.titre: Smells great, feels soft and smooth
avis.texte: Very nice eye cream. It felt smooth going on and absorbed quickly, and left my under eye area softer and more supple after only one week of use. I have hooded eyes, so it didn't really do too much for the corners (I've had crinkles there since I was six).
I haven't noticed much if any results, but it feels good on the skin
I never used an eye cream. before, but this will def be part of my daily routine!

I recieved this product, used this product and I absolutey just love it. I use it in the morning and touch up before bed. I leaves my skin feeling hydrated and so silky smooth. I have noticed a difference with my wrinkles, crows feet were really starting to get bad, but after using this I can see a significant change.

I received this as a trial. I noticed when I wake up in the morning I have a line under my right eye. After using this for a week, I noticed it is gone. I don't have under eye puff anymore.
I received this as a trial. I noticed when I wake up in the morning I have a line under my right eye. After using this for a week, I noticed it is gone. I don't have under eye puff anymore.

avis.titre: Good eyes cream for night time
avis.texte: Nourishes, moisturizes, brightens a little - yes. The texture of the cream is delicate, easily absorbed, there is no irritation, but there is a little oily sheen. Good use for night.

Redermic C. Vitamin C eye cream definitely held up to my expectations i only had a Small container to try but i had improvement with the 2 times it was put on. I highly recommend this especially if you're vitamins are lower than others

Redermic C. Vitamin C eye cream definitely held up to my expectations i only had a Small container to try but i had improvement with the 2 times it was put on. I highly recommend this especially if you're vitamins are lower than others
every other night and everyday to moisturize and brighten my eyes
It helps smooth my aging dry skin around my eyes and works well under makeup. My go to product now!
I bought this product online. Product arrived unsealed. I had to go the store and return it since this product was only available online. Very disappointed!
Nice product highly recommend the eye cream love the way my skin has responed.
I have extremely sensitive skin. This is the only line of skin care I can use. After a few uses I have seen results already

I really like this product. It is light, but moisturizes without being too heavy or greasy. It contains dimethicone and hyaluronic acid which is great but the vitamin C used is not very stable. No added fragrance either.
I've been using this for years and really think it works great and my eye area looks pretty good for a now 70 yr old

avis.titre: Best eye cream I ever used
avis.texte: I have fairly dry skin and this is the first eye cream that I don't have to reapply during the day. It is also the first that makes a visible difference for me. I have sensitive eyes and this cream doesn't irritate them.

avis.titre: Redermic C vitamin C eye cream
avis.texte: I have been using this vitamin C eye cream for a year and I noticed how it made my smile lines on the corner of my eyes disappear. It goes on smooth, doesn't cake and all you need is a pea size. Vitamin C is very important for the face so I use Redermic C in combination with my vitamin c serum and facial cream. Great results.
Light feel eye cream. Perfect for day or night. I love this product!
So fast to show you the result No fine lines no fainting and my eye became more beautiful and pure

This has been the most effective eye cream that I've used! It actually does what it says it says it will do. It softens any fine lines around my eyes and helps brighten. I gave 4 stars b/c it is pricey, but the tube lasts me a good long time! I also use the pigmentclar eye cream in the a.m.
Excellent product. This removed the fine lines in my eyelids in 2-3 weeks. Highly recommended

I have only been using for two weeks, so cannot review about any visual changes yet. I can say that it is a good cream for sensitive eyes. It is sort of thick, so I put a dab of the eye cream in my palm then add a dab of my facial moisturizer to thin it out and this way it's easier to apply to delicate skin around the eyes.

Started using this a few months ago and I'm such a fan. I was really seeing such a huge amount of fine lines starting to creep up in my eyes. This goes on well, is a great price and lasts a long time.

avis.titre: Exactly what I was looking for
avis.texte: I am really enjoying this eye cream. I use this in the morning and the hyaluronic acid eye cream from LRP at bedtime. I love the combo! It has definitely helped the area around my eyes not be so puffy (which was my #1 concern; #2 is preventative against crows feet/wrinkles). The skin is also softer and smoother. I also feel my eyes look brighter/more awake.
I just started using this product but it has so far worked wonderful. I use it during the day and the R product at night.
Overall am happy with moisturizing ability. Packaging causes extra product to come out. Some caking overnight.

avis.titre: I like the eye cream - packaging needs work
avis.texte: I like the eye cream a lot. A little goes a long way with this cream however, for the first few weeks of use, every time I would squeeze to get a small drop the cream would just continue to ooze out. I tried everything from barely squeezing to putting the cap on right away but a lot of it ended up oozing out into the cap. I started taking the eye cream that oozed out and putting it into a separate container. I think for this reason alone I probably wouldn't buy again as eye cream is expensive and I don't like waste.
I have been using this product for a while and I feel my wrinkles are less.

It's a expensive product but in my opinion is worth the price I paid in it. The packing is very nice and easy to handle. This is very useful to moisturize the eye region and give better appearance to dark circles.
I have been using this product for a few months. It works really well at helping reduce the dark circles under my eyes, bags and bonus less wrinkles.

I have tried several types of treatment for wrinkles , all the good names and recognized brands , but still I was not having my results satisfactory or my skin was not showing any changes . But I will tell you that I am in love with Redermic C yes cream and I will say to every women over 35 to start right know and with couple days you will see a big ... big difference in all skin aspect . You will feel light and the deep wrinkle will be less! Thank you so much laroche-posay for creating something so amazing that I can't leave without !

Im only 23 years old and already have so many fine lines under my eyes, from 10 years or wearing heavy eyeliner and 10 years of aggressively rubbing off my eye makeup. I just recently started getting into skin care and actually never realized that i have fine lines under my eyes, I never really paid attention to my face like that until now. I have been using this product with two months and I can most definitely see a big improvement. I can tell my fine lines are being tighten and firmed. Thank you La-Roche Posay!

This is a great product. I have fine lines around my eyes and it helps to reduce the appearance while keeping the skin around my eyes moisturized. I'm a contact lens wearer and have sensitive skin around my eyes and this product works great.
It's my favorite cream!!!!! I tried several brands, this cream it's the best one!
Smooth texture, hydrating yet absorbs well . Great under eye with makeup application. Very pleased.
I absolutely love this. I tried different products and this one made a huge improvement on my under eyes dryness and wrinkles since day two!!!!
Texture is great, glides on, gentle enough and effective for under eyes, great under makeup, hydrating!
Ive used this for a year and honestly havent seen any results. Love the brand but this particular product I dont know, it does not work for me.

It's been just a week since I started using this cream and I'm absolutely amazed with rhe result I've got! My eye hollows dissappeared! I was sure the only option to correct that problem was dermal filler, which I did not want to do, but just a week of using this cream 95% of my hollows are gone! I didn't even dream to have this result! Much more then I expected! Gives great hydration and light reflection as well, also the color in the under eye zone is much better; dark circles are also gone! Thank you Laroche-posay!

I have very sensitive skin as well as dry skin around the eye area. This does not irritate my eyes or skin and it moisturizes beautifully. Makeup goes on smoothly without visible creases. Also, I feel like it has somehow improved the look of my under eye bags and dark circles.
Keeps the skin plumped and nourished.i see less dark circles and fine lines.

avis.titre: Perfect eye cream for my sensitive skin
avis.texte: I am so happy that this eye cream was recommended by my esthetician. I love the texture and how easily it flows and blends onto the eye area without rubbing it in. I have sensitive skin and this product doesn't bother my skin at all.
applies very easy, and absorbs vey well. Eye make up can be applied instantly. Great product
This product goes on easily and seems to give an instant tightening effect. I use it in combination with the version for the face.

I have being using la roche products for over 2 years and I love the results so far. My face looks so fresh, firmer and smoother. The appearance of the skin under my eyes looks so much better. I use this product in the morning and REDERMIC R EYES WITH RETINOL at night. 100% recommended.

avis.titre: Extraordinary Product, Simply The Best Eye Cream
avis.texte: This eye cream is absolutely sensational for helping me combat the signs of aging. It truly transforms the look of the skin beneath my eyes. It gives the texture of the skin a glowing, translucent effect. It also has a moisturizing effect that fills in the wrinkles so they become so unnoticeable that they look practically non-existent. This eye cream is definitely my ammunition for combating aging. I make sure to never run out of this as no other eye cream can replace it and I have tried many throughout the years. This one is truly remarkable and should be given an award for its amazing anti-aging benefits!
Unfortunately did not work for me. Skin became very greasy...☹️
Softens and reduces wrinkles while effectively moisturizing under eye area.
Use it in the morning before makeup and in the evening before bed

La Roche-Posay is an incredible line. I use all the (R) and (C) I have seen the difference in few weeks and felt the difference in the mornings after treatment at night. Great price. Great Brand. Sensitive skin and have not once had an issue.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I've been using this product for the past couple of weeks and it's the best eye cream I've tried in the last year. it really does firm the areas around the eyes. My husband has also noticed the firmness in my skin. It doesn't irritate your eyes or burn the area around the eyes.
